response.overview: Germany, November 1938. Bartosz, a young worker and former Hitler Youth boy, sits by candlelight writing to his brother. A Swiss student has tried to kill Hitler, and the news won’t leave his head. By morning, a postcard arrives with three words that seem to change everything. Then comes a second message, and with it a quiet test of what he truly believes. A short, dreamlike study of obedience, hope, and what a man does when the world he was raised in refuses to end.
response.tagline: HITLER IS DEAD. HITLER IS ALIVE.
response.title: the death of hitler
